entries.en: Nice. Had somethin' similar, but none of that nomad shit.

entries.en: First, beg your pardon. And second – brunette.

entries.en: Mhm. Lemme guess – big, busty blonde on the side?

entries.en: Shit... No fixin' this. What's wrecked is wrecked.
entries.ro: Rahat... Nu se mai repară. Ce e distrus, e distrus.
